worker: order gives 107 and the 30-cent order gives 30.
- `src/invoice/invoice.test.js`: the 35-cent order as three quantity-1 lines and as one quantity-3 line (1.07), and the 30-cent order (0.30), plus an agreement test. Expected values in the new tests are hand-derived from `docs/MONEY.md`. I added one import line to `invoice.test.js`; the existing assertions are untouched.

My first batched shell command was denied, so I redid the edits with the file tools. Nothing from the denied command was applied.
